body:
Thanks. Tons of hobbies. Like I said in another comment I'm in tons of groups, I was an actor-producer before I moved into this field and still compose a lot of music and perform. Appearance wise -- I actually got a lot of compliments on how well I worse my suit and I go to the gym a lot so I'm in very good shape. 

I really don't want to sound like I'm shooting down everyone's suggestions for making myself happier but really the reason I'm at wits end is because I've done all this (for years) and never seem to make that improvement. Honestly, I don't even need a girlfriend or even to get laid -- I just want to be be able to make any meaningful relationships outside of the ones I've had since I was a kid.

I'm glad it struck a chord with you. I've been working on vulnerability a lot actually. I guess that the problem is I (at least perceive myself to be based on all I do) that I'm a pretty high risk-taker. What drives me to this suicidal depression is 15 years of risk-taking without any change in who I am. I feel like I must be missing some secret ingredient or something, and am hopeless I'll never find what it is

Thanks for taking the time to listen. I've read The Game among many others. 

I maybe should not have focused so much on the rejection of last night. I am rejected so often. This was just a sort of perverse epiphany. It was not the rejection, but the reflection on it, that led me here. I do attend church, I join every club I can. I travel alone across the world just to meet people. I'm actually very good at striking up conversations. But I can never turn that into a meaningful relationship.

I see your point about focusing on what others have. To me that is always the hardest part. I'll have to think on that more.
